sufficient_sets.text: The disease was caused by the bacterium Yersinia pestis, which is primarily spread by flea bites, though it may also spread through contact with infected tissues or fluids and, in pneumonic cases, through respiratory droplets.

labels.answer_text: Yersinia pestis, which is primarily spread by flea bites
